deviations: Weak-runtime fallback was used: three directions were produced serially in one self-contained artifact rather than by isolated subagents.

The three directions share one complete state-machine implementation; their entry composition, capture guidance, progress treatment, typography and container geometry differ, but they are less structurally independent than three separately authored prototypes.
No official brand identity or design system was supplied; invented labels, colors, review timing and simulated failure controls are explicitly marked Mock.

Browser QA used headless Google Chrome with an in-page deterministic click harness because Playwright was unavailable in the worktree. Raw DOM, screenshots, consoleErrors and pageErrors were persisted.
